name: playwright
description: End-to-end testing with Playwright — role/test-id locators, web-first assertions, no fixed sleeps, fixtures, page objects only where they pay off, test isolation; CI setup with app and service startup, retries and traces, sharding, GPU-less and display-less runners; and testing canvas-centric apps via state and DOM overlays, selective screenshots and graceful WebGPU degradation. Depends on `core` and `typescript`.
